§3§lPreparation and use§r
Place the Wireless Energy Monitor and right-click to open its interface; no power connection is needed. The measurement anchor selects wireless stored EU, §15-second§r average EU/t or instantaneous EU/t. Parameters accept direct entry and scientific notation, such as §11.5E6§r.

§3§lRedstone control§r
The redstone button offers §15§r modes: Off; output above Param1; output below Param1; High-Hysteresis (enable above Param1, disable below Param2); and Low-Hysteresis (enable below Param2, disable above Param1). Signal strength is §115§r, with checks every §12 ticks§r. Data updates every §1100 ticks§r over a §1300-second§r history window.

§3§lQuest requirements§r
Obtain §11§r comparator and tick the quest after understanding the measurement target and threshold directions. The comparator is §2detected without consumption§r; the quest does not automatically check the redstone circuit or parameter settings.
